physics_digest.algorithm: sha256 over canonical json of the artifact with the benchmark/metadata blocks and all timing-valued keys removed

prior_sensitivity.interpretation: variance-based indices are relative to the sampling distribution: a wide linear range can hide a regime that a log-uniform prior visits. The registry range is not a probability distribution.
prior_sensitivity.why_not_reportable: the log-uniform prior reaches the low-shunt region where the model's own extraction invariants fail (electrical.range.ff / pce_pct / jmp_ma_cm2), and the remaining complete-design indices at this N are estimator-noise dominated (an FF first-order index of -1.11 is not a physical statement). The distribution dependence is therefore reported from the response-shape evidence and deferred to V1.9-E, where the prior/uncertainty machinery belongs.

regime_comparison.criterion: regime_dependent if index range across regimes exceeds max(0.10, 2x the mean replicate spread)
